title: Jawa's Lightsaber
description: 🔦Adds lightsabers from Star Wars to Minecraft
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1747/128/image_2026-06-21_022140215-png.png)

 

Jawa's Lightsaber Mod adds LIGHT SABERS to Minecraft. Lightabser in Starwars is a weapon mainly wield by Jedi or Sith, but now everybody can use them. They work differently fromother weapons but light sabers are very fun to play with.

  

It's basically a mutlitool that can burn entities, including item on the ground and produce heat that can smelt items (like a portable furnace). They need to be ignited/turn on to work, and the weapon will turn off if you switch for a different slot.

[![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1747/163/pasted-png.png)](https://www.youtube.com/@FurtiTwo)   

Lightsaber can be crafted with a gem and will have a color by default (Diamond gives Blue, Amethyst Purple, Redstone red...) but they can also be dyed in a crafting table (my red light saber is now blue)

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1747/139/image_2026-06-21_023303860-png.png)   

Projectiles can be blocked with your weapon but can also send them back by right clicking.

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/1747/148/image_2026-06-21_024449425-png.png)   

Jawa's Lightsaber is compatible with Better Combat

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/474/153/logo.png)
